title: DatasetManifest
description: Canonical dataset release manifest schema. Tracks versioning, seeds, commit SHA, row counts, checksums, and validation status.

config_name.description: Name of the configuration profile used (e.g. dev, ml-dev, benchmark, fixture).

global_seed.description: Global random seed driving all generator sub-seeds.

generator_git_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the generator code used to create this dataset release.

row_counts.description: Mapping of table or split name to actual generated row count.

treatment_rate.description: Empirical treatment assignment rate among eligible customers.

file_checksums.description: Mapping of relative file path to SHA-256 checksum string. Never use fake placeholders.

validation_status.description: Statistical and schema validation status. Defaults to not_run before dataset validation.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of dataset creation.
